title: Presales (Data, AI & Fullstack) - Senior Consultant
description:
**Presales – Data / AI / Full Stack**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a
**Presales professional**
with strong experience in
**Data, AI, and Full Stack technologies**
to support business development, solutioning, and client engagements. The role will involve understanding client requirements, designing technical solutions, preparing proposals, and supporting sales teams during the complete presales cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**




+ Understand client business and technical requirements and translate them into effective technology solutions.
+ Develop solution approaches, architectures, and technical proposals across Data, AI, and Full Stack technologies.
+ Prepare RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, SOWs, and solution documents.
+ Conduct client presentations, technical discussions, demos, and solution walkthroughs.
+ Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Architects, and Engineering teams to create winning solutions.
+ Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud, and Full Stack technologies.
+ Provide effort estimates, high-level project plans, and technology recommendations.
+ Support proof-of-concepts (POCs) and technical demonstrations.
+ Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack development.
+ Participate in client workshops and requirement-gathering sessions.
+ Support the sales team in identifying new opportunities and strengthening existing client relationships.

**Required Skills**




+ Strong understanding of Data Engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, and Full Stack development.
+ Knowledge of Python, Java/.NET, React/Angular, APIs, Microservices, and databases.
+ Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
+ Knowledge of data technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Data Lake, ETL/ELT, and BI tools.
+ Understanding of AI/ML frameworks, LLMs, GenAI, RAG, and AI application development.
+ Strong solution architecture and technical documentation skills.
+ Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills.
+ Ability to work effectively with Sales, Delivery, and Technical teams.

**Experience**




+ 8+ years of overall experience in technology, solutioning, consulting, or presales.
+ Relevant experience in Data / AI / Full Stack Presales or Solution Architecture is preferred.

**Preferred**




+ Experience handling RFP/RFI/RFQ and large enterprise proposals.
+ Experience in client-facing roles and technical presentations.
+ Experience supporting sales pursuits in the US/global market.
+ Relevant cloud or AI certifications will be an added advantage.

title: Solution Architect (AI / Data / Full Stack) - Senior Principal Consultant
description:
Solution Architect – AI / Data / Full Stack
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect**
with strong expertise in
**AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack technologies**
. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions and working closely with clients, business teams, and engineering teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design end-to-end technology solutions across AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack platforms.
* Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable solution architectures.
* Define application architecture, technology stack, integration patterns, APIs, and data architecture.
* Design solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Analytics.
* Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to development and engineering teams.
* Review technical designs, code approaches, and architecture decisions.
* Support POCs, technical evaluations, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with Presales and Sales teams on RFPs, proposals, estimations, and client presentations.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, performance, availability, and maintainability.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend suitable solutions based on business needs.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in Solution Architecture and Enterprise Application Design.
* Strong knowledge of AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI application development.
* Strong understanding of Data Engineering, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT, Databricks, Snowflake, and Analytics.
* Good experience with Full Stack technologies such as Python/Java/.NET, React/Angular, APIs, and Microservices.
* Strong knowledge of Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms.
* Experience with databases, distributed systems, integration, and API architecture.
* Strong understanding of security, scalability, performance, and cloud architecture.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client-facing skills.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, architecture, or technology consulting.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect / Technical Architect across AI, Data, Cloud, or Full Stack technologies.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with enterprise/global clients.
* Experience in client-facing architecture discussions and technical workshops.
* Experience in presales, RFP/RFI responses, and solution proposals.
* Cloud, AI, Data, or Architecture certifications will be an added advantage.
